from docx import Document
from docx.shared import Pt, RGBColor, Inches, Cm
from docx.enum.text import WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH
from docx.enum.table import WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT
from docx.enum.section import WD_ORIENT
from docx.oxml.ns import qn
from docx.oxml import OxmlElement

SEV_COLORS = {"Critical": "C00000", "High": "E26B0A", "Medium": "BF8F00", "Low": "548235"}

def new_doc():
    d = Document()
    st = d.styles["Normal"]
    st.font.name = "Calibri"
    st.font.size = Pt(10.5)
    st.element.rPr.rFonts.set(qn("w:eastAsia"), "Calibri")
    pf = st.paragraph_format
    pf.space_after = Pt(5)
    pf.line_spacing = 1.08
    for name, size, color in [("Heading 1", 14, "1F3864"), ("Heading 2", 12, "1F3864"), ("Heading 3", 11, "2E74B5")]:
        h = d.styles[name]
        h.font.name = "Calibri"
        h.font.size = Pt(size)
        h.font.bold = True
        h.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(color)
        h.element.rPr.rFonts.set(qn("w:eastAsia"), "Calibri")
        h.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(10)
        h.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(4)
        h.paragraph_format.keep_with_next = True
    sec = d.sections[0]
    sec.left_margin = sec.right_margin = Inches(0.9)
    sec.top_margin = sec.bottom_margin = Inches(0.85)
    return d

def shade(cell, hexcolor):
    tcPr = cell._tc.get_or_add_tcPr()
    shd = OxmlElement("w:shd")
    shd.set(qn("w:val"), "clear")
    shd.set(qn("w:color"), "auto")
    shd.set(qn("w:fill"), hexcolor)
    tcPr.append(shd)

def add_runs(p, text, size=None, color=None, italic=False):
    # supports **bold** segments
    parts = text.split("**")
    for i, seg in enumerate(parts):
        if not seg:
            continue
        r = p.add_run(seg)
        r.bold = (i % 2 == 1)
        r.italic = italic
        if size:
            r.font.size = Pt(size)
        if color:
            r.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(color)
    return p

def para(d, text, bold=False, italic=False, size=None, align=None, color=None, after=None, indent=None):
    p = d.add_paragraph()
    if bold:
        text = "**" + text + "**"
    add_runs(p, text, size=size, color=color, italic=italic)
    if align == "center":
        p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    if after is not None:
        p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(after)
    if indent:
        p.paragraph_format.left_indent = Inches(indent)
    return p

def bullet(d, text, level=0, numbered=False):
    style = "List Number" if numbered else ("List Bullet" if level == 0 else "List Bullet 2")
    p = d.add_paragraph(style=style)
    add_runs(p, text)
    p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(2)
    return p

def quote(d, text):
    p = d.add_paragraph()
    add_runs(p, text, italic=False)
    p.paragraph_format.left_indent = Inches(0.4)
    p.paragraph_format.right_indent = Inches(0.3)
    pPr = p._p.get_or_add_pPr()
    bdr = OxmlElement("w:pBdr")
    left = OxmlElement("w:left")
    left.set(qn("w:val"), "single"); left.set(qn("w:sz"), "12"); left.set(qn("w:space"), "8"); left.set(qn("w:color"), "8EAADB")
    bdr.append(left); pPr.append(bdr)
    return p

def set_col_widths(table, widths):
    for row in table.rows:
        for i, w in enumerate(widths):
            if i < len(row.cells):
                row.cells[i].width = Inches(w)

def table(d, header, rows, widths, font=9, header_fill="1F3864", sev_col=None):
    t = d.add_table(rows=1, cols=len(header))
    t.style = "Table Grid"
    t.alignment = WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT.CENTER
    for i, h in enumerate(header):
        c = t.rows[0].cells[i]
        c.text = ""
        p = c.paragraphs[0]
        r = p.add_run(h); r.bold = True; r.font.size = Pt(font); r.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(255, 255, 255)
        shade(c, header_fill)
    # repeat header
    trPr = t.rows[0]._tr.get_or_add_trPr()
    th = OxmlElement("w:tblHeader"); th.set(qn("w:val"), "true"); trPr.append(th)
    for row in rows:
        cells = t.add_row().cells
        for i, val in enumerate(row):
            c = cells[i]
            c.text = ""
            lines = str(val).split("\n")
            for j, line in enumerate(lines):
                p = c.paragraphs[0] if j == 0 else c.add_paragraph()
                p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(1)
                add_runs(p, line, size=font)
            if sev_col is not None and i == sev_col and val in SEV_COLORS:
                shade(c, SEV_COLORS[val])
                for p in c.paragraphs:
                    for r in p.runs:
                        r.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(255, 255, 255); r.bold = True
    set_col_widths(t, widths)
    d.add_paragraph().paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(2)
    return t

def kv_table(d, pairs, sev=None, widths=(1.55, 5.15), font=9.5):
    t = d.add_table(rows=0, cols=2)
    t.style = "Table Grid"
    for k, v in pairs:
        cells = t.add_row().cells
        cells[0].text = ""
        r = cells[0].paragraphs[0].add_run(k); r.bold = True; r.font.size = Pt(font)
        shade(cells[0], "D9E2F3")
        cells[1].text = ""
        lines = v.split("\n")
        for j, line in enumerate(lines):
            p = cells[1].paragraphs[0] if j == 0 else cells[1].add_paragraph()
            p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(2)
            if line.startswith("- "):
                p.paragraph_format.left_indent = Inches(0.15)
                line = "• " + line[2:]
            add_runs(p, line, size=font)
        if k == "Severity" and sev in SEV_COLORS:
            shade(cells[1], SEV_COLORS[sev])
            for p in cells[1].paragraphs:
                for r in p.runs:
                    r.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(255, 255, 255); r.bold = True
    set_col_widths(t, widths)
    d.add_paragraph().paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(2)
    return t

def footer(d, text):
    for s in d.sections:
        p = s.footer.paragraphs[0]
        p.text = ""
        r = p.add_run(text); r.font.size = Pt(8); r.italic = True
        p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
        # page number
        r2 = p.add_run("   |   Page "); r2.font.size = Pt(8)
        fld1 = OxmlElement("w:fldSimple"); fld1.set(qn("w:instr"), "PAGE")
        rr = OxmlElement("w:r"); tt = OxmlElement("w:t"); tt.text = "1"; rr.append(tt); fld1.append(rr)
        p._p.append(fld1)
